verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's own docs say it generates TOTP codes for saved logins in place of a separate authenticator app, and users report relying on it for all their 2FA. The evidence never says how a TOTP secret gets added, so the QR-scan onboarding step at the heart of this story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented QR-code scanning to add a TOTP secret, evidence the codes start generating immediately after setup, and hands-on confirmation of the scan-to-code flow.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Instead of requiring a separate [authenticator app](/blog/authenticator-app), Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
Proton Pass is my default for all 2FA.
If you are paying for Pass Plus or Proton Unlimited then you have integrated 2FA/TOTP
